name: Houfuku no Josou Chikan
source:
"Alright, that's perfect."

Beautiful long fluttering hair, stylish-looking lips with thinly applied lipstick...
The girl in the mirror was brimming with satisfied laughter.

Walking along the street attracted the attention of the guys - it was an extreme beauty. Unfortunately, though, what should've been a girl, was actually a boy.

The protagonist is a boy who loves women and hates men. That, coupled with his blunt manner of speaking, had been the cause of more than a few bad experiences in the past. (Experiences where they made fun of his androgynous looks and made him dress up as a girl.)

Time passes and the protagonist will finally be able to exact his revenge on his former torturers. He will dress up as a girl, make the girls drop their defenses, sneak up to them and get his revenge by molesting them.

[Translated from the [url=http://massel.jp/jyosoutikan/story.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
“好吧，那就完美了。”

美丽的长发随风飘扬，时尚的嘴唇涂着薄薄的口红……
镜子里的少女脸上洋溢着满足的笑声。

走在街上，吸引了小伙子们的注意——那是一种极致的美。但不幸的是，本来应该是女孩的，实际上却是男孩。

主角是一个爱女人恨男人的男孩。再加上他说话的直率，导致了他之前发生过不少糟糕的经历。（他们取笑他雌雄同体的外表并让他打扮成女孩的经历。）时间流逝，主角终于能够向昔日的施虐者报仇。他会打扮成女孩，让女孩们放下防备，偷偷接近她们，通过猥亵她们来报复。

[翻译自[url=http://massel.jp/jyosoutikan/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
